name: heat-risk
title_zh: 把体感温度算成可执行的热风险分级
tagline_zh: 当天气预报说 35°C 而体感 41°C，你还在凭感觉决定要不要停工？它把温湿度、风速、日照揉成一张风险表。
tagline_en: When the forecast says 35°C but it feels like 41°C, stop guessing. It fuses humidity, wind, and sun into a risk.
why_zh: 不是简单套用热指数公式，而是按湿球黑球温度（WBGT）标准分层，把劳动强度、着装。
why_en: Goes beyond a heat-index calculator—uses WBGT standards, folds in workload, clothing, and sun exposure, and outputs action.
limit_zh: 只覆盖户外露天作业场景，室内空调环境会误报；需要输入湿球温度（非干球），且默认无风、无云，极端高湿或阵风天气结果偏差大。
limit_en: Outdoor work only; indoor AC spaces misread. Requires wet-bulb input (not dry-bulb), assumes no wind/cloud, skews in high humidity or gusts; not an.
